info.name: AI Learning Platform — Course API
info.description:
All requests go through the **API gateway** (default `http://localhost:4000`). Paths use `/api/courses/...`; the gateway rewrites to `/api/v1/courses/...` on the course service.

---

## Collection variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:4000` | Gateway URL — use this for all requests |
| `courseServiceUrl` | `http://localhost:3003` | Direct course-service URL — bypass gateway (debug only) |
| `accessToken` | _(empty)_ | Paste your JWT here after sign-in via the Auth collection |
| `courseId` | _(empty)_ | Auto-set by test scripts on any Generate Course call |

---

## Quick reference — valid enum values

### subject
| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `FINANCE` | Finance & trading tracks |
| `PROGRAMMING` | Software & tech tracks |

### track — FINANCE subject
| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `FOREX_TRADING` | Foreign exchange markets, currency pairs, technical & fundamental analysis |
| `STOCK_MARKET` | Equities, fundamental analysis, valuation, portfolio management |
| `CRYPTO_BLOCKCHAIN` | Cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, DeFi, tokenomics |
| `PERSONAL_FINANCE` | Budgeting, savings, debt management, investing basics |
| `OPTIONS_DERIVATIVES` | Options, futures, swaps, derivatives pricing & strategies |

### track — PROGRAMMING subject
| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `PYTHON` | Python programming from syntax to advanced patterns |
| `WEB_DEVELOPMENT` | HTML/CSS/JS, frontend frameworks, backend APIs, full-stack |
| `AI_MACHINE_LEARNING` | ML fundamentals, supervised/unsupervised learning, model training |
| `AI_ENGINEERING` | LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, production AI systems |
| `CYBERSECURITY` | Ethical hacking, penetration testing, offensive & defensive security |
| `DATA_STRUCTURES_ALGORITHMS` | DSA, complexity analysis, problem-solving patterns, interview prep |

### level
| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `BEGINNER` | First principles — zero prior knowledge assumed |
| `INTERMEDIATE` | Builds on fundamentals — some experience expected |
| `ADVANCED` | Deep dives — practitioner-level detail |
| `MASTERY` | Institutional/professional depth — the real thing, not a summary |

---

## Async generation flow
1. `POST /api/courses/generate` → returns `202` immediately with `{ courseId, status: "GENERATING" }`
2. Poll `GET /api/courses/:id/status` until status is `READY` or `FAILED`
3. Once `READY`, call `GET /api/courses/:id` for the full nested course

---

## Auth
Every course endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. The gateway validates the JWT before forwarding the request. Get a token from the Auth API collection (Sign in or Sign up).

request.description:
Bypasses the gateway. Use only for local debugging.
Production clients must always go through the gateway.

Step 1 of 2. Copy the `data` object from the response into the body of "2. Persist content" below (or just run `npm run generate:course-content` at the repo root, which does both steps for every published course).

Step 2 of 2. Body is the `data` object returned by step 1 (module/lesson tree). Replaces the course's entire module tree — idempotent, safe to re-run. `courseId` must be an existing catalog course id (see GET /api/v1/courses).

Poll after `generate`. Returns:
```json
{ "courseId": "...", "status": "GENERATING" }
```

**status values:**
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `GENERATING` | Background generation still running — keep polling |
| `READY` | All modules and lessons are saved — call `GET /api/courses/:id` |
| `FAILED` | Generation failed — response includes `errorMessage` with the reason |

Returns the full nested course once status is `READY`.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "userId": "uuid",
  "subject": "PROGRAMMING",
  "track": "CYBERSECURITY",
  "level": "BEGINNER",
  "title": "Introduction to Ethical Hacking",
  "description": "...",
  "learningObjectives": ["Understand TCP/IP", "..." ],
  "prerequisites": ["Basic computer literacy"],
  "estimatedDurationMinutes": 600,
  "status": "READY",
  "modules": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "title": "Networking Fundamentals",
      "description": "...",
      "position": 1,
      "lessons": [
        {
          "id": "uuid",
          "title": "How TCP/IP Works",
          "content": "...",
          "position": 1,
          "workedExamples": [
            { "id": "uuid", "title": "...", "problem": "...", "solution": "...", "position": 1 }
          ],
          "practiceExercises": [
            { "id": "uuid", "question": "...", "hint": "...", "answer": "...", "difficulty": "EASY" }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "createdAt": "2026-04-17T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-04-17T10:02:30.000Z"
}
```

Returns a paginated list of all courses belonging to the authenticated user.

**Optional query parameters:**
| Param | Values | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `subject` | `FINANCE` \| `PROGRAMMING` | `?subject=PROGRAMMING` |
| `track` | Any track value (see table below) | `?track=CYBERSECURITY` |
| `level` | `BEGINNER` \| `INTERMEDIATE` \| `ADVANCED` \| `MASTERY` | `?level=BEGINNER` |
| `page` | integer ≥ 1 (default `1`) | `?page=2` |
| `limit` | integer 1–100 (default `20`) | `?limit=5` |

**All track values:**
```
FINANCE:     FOREX_TRADING, STOCK_MARKET, CRYPTO_BLOCKCHAIN, PERSONAL_FINANCE, OPTIONS_DERIVATIVES
PROGRAMMING: PYTHON, WEB_DEVELOPMENT, AI_MACHINE_LEARNING, AI_ENGINEERING, CYBERSECURITY, DATA_STRUCTURES_ALGORITHMS
```

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "courses": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "subject": "PROGRAMMING",
      "track": "CYBERSECURITY",
      "level": "BEGINNER",
      "title": "Introduction to Ethical Hacking",
      "status": "READY",
      "estimatedDurationMinutes": 600,
      "createdAt": "2026-04-17T10:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 5,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 20,
    "totalPages": 1
  }
}
```

item.name: List My Courses — filter by track=CYBERSECURITY
List My Courses — filter by subject + level + pagination

request.description: Combined filter — FINANCE courses at BEGINNER level, 10 per page.
No Authorization header — gateway returns `401 Unauthorized` before the request even reaches the course-service.

Invalid subject `MATHS` — course-service returns `400 Bad Request`.

Valid values: `FINANCE` | `PROGRAMMING`

Invalid track `HACKING` — course-service returns `400 Bad Request`.

Use `CYBERSECURITY` for ethical hacking content.

Invalid level `EXPERT` — course-service returns `400 Bad Request`.

Valid values: `BEGINNER` | `INTERMEDIATE` | `ADVANCED` | `MASTERY`
Non-existent courseId — course-service returns `404 Not Found`.

To test: sign in as **User A**, generate a course, copy the courseId. Then sign in as **User B**, paste User B's token as `accessToken`, and send this request with User A's courseId.

Expected: `403 Forbidden` — course-service verifies that the requesting userId matches the course owner.
